# dnsgate_zones (Data Source)

The zones the provider identity can read in the gate, with their ownership counts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dnsgate_zones" "route53" {
  dns_provider = "route53"
}

output "route53_zones" {
  value = data.dnsgate_zones.route53.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dns_provider` (String) Keep only the zones of this DNS provider instance or kind, as the gate names it (for example `route53`).
- `include_unmanaged` (Boolean) Also list the zones discovered in the provider account but not managed by the gate (read-only). Default `false`.

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Zone names, sorted.
- `zones` (Attributes List) Zones sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `dns_provider` (String) DNS provider of the zone in the gate.
- `foreign` (Number) RRsets not owned by the gate.
- `managed` (Number) RRsets owned by the gate.
- `pending` (Number)
- `rrsets` (Number) RRsets in the zone.
- `tainted` (Number) RRsets modified outside the gate.
- `unmanaged` (Boolean) Discovered, not managed: read-only.
- `zone` (String)
